briefing.headline: OpenAI o4-preview and DeepSeek-R2 intensify AGI race as safety gaps widen

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs accelerate model releases amid record funding while regulatory scrutiny mounts. Prompt injection attacks continue to expose production systems globally. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation emerges as a protocol-level defense gaining traction in enterprise pilots.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI ships o4-preview with advanced reasoning; Anthropic counters with Claude 4 Opus; DeepSeek-R2 claims parity at lower cost; Meta open-sources Llama 4 405B variant; xAI deploys Grok-3 beta.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level, with new patents filed for CAN bus and IoT extensions.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp hits 1M units monthly; Google announces $8B Arizona supercluster; Microsoft and xAI expand Memphis data center with 200k H100 equivalents.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will protocol-level defenses like dynamic dialects become mandatory for all frontier deployments by 2028?
